card.name: Daily after "once" in dosing
card.fires_on: The word "daily" (or "day" in "once a day") right after "once" in dose instructions. It appears in dosage and administration sections of drug labels.

modes.description: "daily" completing the phrase "once daily" after a dose amount or the verb administered.
